names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Αυγούστου, «Άγιοι Νεόφυτος, Ζήνων, Γάιος, Μάρκος, Μακάριος και Γαϊανός», with the rank word left off. The page gives him a head line of his own, «Αγιος Μαρκος», and glosses the name from the Latin marceo, «ο αδιάφορος προς τα υλικά επίγεια».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιοι Νεόφυτος, Ζήνων, Γάιος, Μάρκος, Μακάριος και Γαϊανός»

attestations.note: The fourth of the six the one listing line names, with his own head line on the shared page. The page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Three of the six — Neophytos, Gaius and Gaianos — are refused and not drafted, because the corpus already keeps three men of exactly those names with `greek` rows venerated on 5 Μαΐου, saint.gr's «Άγιοι Νεόφυτος, Γάιος και Γαϊανός οι Μάρτυρες», and nothing on either page settles whether they are the same men; the reader's report names the question. The page's second distich is addressed to this Mark with Macarius and Gaianos, «Eις τον Mάρκον, Mακάριον, και Γαϊανόν». No year, no hymn, no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The corpus keeps many men named Mark and none of them in this company; the distinguisher is the day, as the corpus does it elsewhere.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
